summary: The veterinary student path. After sign-in the dashboard offers an ordinary account a veterinary path, and /account/vet-profile asks whether it is a veterinary student or a veterinarian; choosing nothing is a complete answer, no role is added and the account is never replaced. A student application needs a name, a student number (normalised like a council code, only a plausible shape required because no official format is known) and a university, with an optional private student card. It creates a STUDENT professional case with an immutable version-1 submission, under an account row lock so two simultaneous submissions cannot open two cases. The association admin decides by hand, and the association admin is the Phase 1 association operator (DEC-0190), together with the superadmin; the Phase 2 review operator, a trusted vet and every other context are refused. Every decision (verify, request correction, reject) carries a reason, cannot be taken on one's own case or on a stale version, notifies the applicant, and is recorded in the case audit. A correction is answered with a new submission version while the earlier one stays; a rejection is final for that case and a new application may follow. Verification rechecks eligibility, creates the canonical vet_profile as STUDENT (still a draft, no role), marks the case VERIFIED_STUDENT and gives the one student tag in the same transaction. replaceVetTag itself now accepts the student tag only from a verified student case of the same account and refuses every doctor tag on a student profile. A verified student cannot publish a directory page (from any manager), add a place of practice, be an advertising target or purchase target, see the directory editor, or file a Phase 2 doctor application; the student path in turn is closed to accounts with a doctor profile, a tag, the trusted veterinarian role or any other open case, and a doctor application is refused while a student case is open. The applicant sees status, reviewer reasons and the full history (from the case audit, without reviewer identities) on the account page and in the dashboard JSON; the association has a queue with open, correction and decided views, a detail page with every submitted version, the private card, the same student number on other accounts and the history, a count on its overview and a navigation entry.

limitations: There is no path from a verified student to a doctor; no prompt of this package specifies graduation, so a student profile stays a student until a product decision.
A student case cannot be withdrawn by the applicant; the model allows it but the prompt does not ask for it.
Deciding a submitted case performs the start of review and the decision in one step; claiming a case for review is PROMPT-007.
The path choice is not stored on the account: its only real effect is the application it leads to.
On success the application and decision forms are replaced by the persisted case state instead of showing a success banner; the status card is the confirmation.
The history shown to the applicant is read from the audit trail, so it depends on audit retention.
The student number shape is a plausibility check only; no official format or registry check exists.
